release_notes:
• Guide Indent matrix — choose Side and/or Top placement independently for the tip, narrowest point and butt, to suit how you scrape.

• Notes — a drop-down box under Shaper Name for your own notes; saved inside the preset and shown again whenever that shape is loaded.

• Scale Shape exclusion — keep one region (e.g. the tube) at its original size while the rest scales; a Transition distance blends the two, and Lock keeps the region at its original distance from the tip.

• Populate Points — sample the current curve at a set interval (e.g. every 5 mm) so you can refine a shape without losing its outline. Existing points are kept.

• Load Preset as Reference — the preview is greyed while you pick the reference, so you can't switch presets by accident.

• Width tooltip — hovering shows the working and reference widths in one box for direct comparison; 'Working Shape' / 'Reference Shape' labels show which is in front.

• User Settings — your bolt hole, guide indent and alignment post defaults are remembered between sessions, with an option to let presets sent to you override them.

• Gouge Orientation — Smile (the default, as always) or Frown, which flips the gouge the other way up.

• Chamfer — the sharp top edge of the concave half is chamfered along its full length, so prints come out smooth with no sanding. On by default; untick to export as before.

• Automatic backups — every time you generate a shaper, its preset is backed up. Forgot to save? Presets → Restore Preset Backup. Kept for 90 days by default (30, 60 or Keep all in User Settings).

• Licence management — Show Licence lists your activations and lets you deactivate this computer. Activating a new computer lets you choose which old activation to replace.
